name: mso-conflict
why: A mandatory start earlier than its link allows keeps its date, records a conflict and pushes negative float onto the predecessor. A start-no-earlier constraint simply holds c later.

a.why: LF = min(PF 10, LS_b 7 - 0) = 7, LS = 7 - 10 = -3, TF -3: negative float is shown, never hidden. FF = ES_b 5 - result 10 = -5.

b.why: MSO Mon 8 Mar = index 5, so ES 5 although the link gives 10 (Mon 15 Mar): conflict, and ab is not driving because 10 is not ES. LF = PF 10.

c.why: SNET Wed 10 Mar = index 7; ES = max(0, 7).
